name: Tuam Mafamut
bio: When a new agreement is brought ashore, this councillor asks what the court will have to concede next. He is not the ruler whose name Pires also renders Mafamut.
notes: fact: Pires has him urge action against the Portuguese in 1509 and oppose peace in 1511; Pires says he later died at Portuguese hands without elaborating (Pires II, pp. 256, 280)
gameplay: His questions and affiliations in play are invented; no port rank or merchant client is assigned (people-factions.md §§2–3)
